name: Brass: Pittsburgh

rounds.endCondition: Each era ends after the round in which all players have used their final cards

categories.label: Era 1: train links
categories.hint: 1 VP per link icon in locations adjacent to each of your train links (light and heavy).

categories.label: Era 1: flipped industries
categories.hint: VP at bottom left of each flipped industry tile.

categories.label: Era 2: train links
categories.hint: Same as era 1; all trains removed as scored.

categories.label: Era 2: flipped industries
categories.hint: VP of each flipped industry tile still on the board.

categories.label: Crown Jewel end-of-era bonuses
categories.hint: Locomotive Works: 4 VP per heavy train built; Polyphase Alternator: VP = empty industry spaces on your player board.

categories.label: Other VP gained during play
categories.hint: Coke market sale and pipeline VP bonuses etc. already moved on the track.

categories.label: Income level (tiebreak)
categories.hint: Highest space on the income track.

tiebreakers.description: Highest space on the income track
If still tied, the tied players share the win.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Scoring happens at end of each era: first train links (pipeline links do not score; level I industries removed after era 1; era 1 light trains removed as scored, heavy trains stay), then flipped industry tiles (unflipped score nothing). Shortfall penalties are not stated on the pages read; if applicable subtract them in trackScore. Special industries (Locomotive Works, Polyphase Alternator) per the Crown Jewel panel.
